periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, tapering toward the rostrum.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Oval/teardrop shape with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Distinct downward tapering with the inferior margin extending notably further from the geometric center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile along the posterior boundary of the transverse band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Occupies approximately 40% of the visible vertical torso height at the lateral flank.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap equivalent to approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded apex curvature on both visible ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Manual grip of a dark, elongated object positioned at the oral commissure.
